description_en: Queries the monitoring and alerting settings of a synchronization task
description_zh: 查询同步作业的监控报警设置详情
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-synchronization-job-alert --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --synchronization-job-id kxz1170c10p0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSynchronizationJobAlert

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the subscription channel resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定订阅通道所在地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the DescribeSynchronizationJobs operation to query instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据同步实例ID，可以通过调用DescribeSynchronizationJobs接口查询
parameters.name: synchronization_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:

Forward: forward.
Reverse: reverse.

Default value: Forward
parameters.help_zh:
同步方向，取值：

Forward：正向。
Reverse：反向。

默认取值为Forward
parameters.name: synchronization_direction

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The value can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter is about to be discontinued
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

DelayAlertPhone.description_en: The mobile phone number of the contact for latency alerts
DelayAlertPhone.description_zh: 延迟报警的联系人手机号码

DelayAlertStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether latency monitoring is enabled. Valid values:

enable: enabled.
disable: disabled
DelayAlertStatus.description_zh:
是否监控延迟状态，返回值：

enable：是。
disable：否

DelayOverSeconds.description_en: The threshold that triggers a latency alert. Unit: seconds
DelayOverSeconds.description_zh: 触发延迟报警的阈值，单位为秒

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call failed
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

ErrorAlertPhone.description_en: The mobile phone number of the contact for error alerts
ErrorAlertPhone.description_zh: 异常报警的联系人手机号码

ErrorAlertStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether error status monitoring is enabled. Valid values:

enable: enabled.
disable: disabled
ErrorAlertStatus.description_zh:
是否监控异常状态，返回值：

enable：是。
disable：否

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

SynchronizationDirection.description_en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:

Forward: forward.
Reverse: reverse.

Default value: Forward
SynchronizationDirection.description_zh:
同步方向，取值：

Forward：正向。
Reverse：反向。

默认取值为Forward

SynchronizationJobId.description_en: The instance ID of the data synchronization instance

SynchronizationJobName.description_en: The name of the data synchronization task
